post.title: [Paid - $25] Need Amazon KDP Book Cover Formatted & Assembled (Template Provided)
post.body:
Hi everyone,

I’m looking for an experienced Photoshop editor to help put together a full Amazon KDP book cover (front, spine, and back) that adheres strictly to KDP’s template, bleed, and dimension guidelines.

What I have ready for you:

Front Cover: Sample/final design image ready.
Back Cover: Text description, design layout preferences, and the author's photo (to be placed on the back).
KDP Template: Official template generated specifically for this book's exact page count and trim size (includes bleed lines, barcode safety zones, and spine dimensions).

All of these items are included in the Google Drive link I have included in this post.

Technical Requirements:
Must be delivered in PDF format and meet Amazon KDP's standards.
Minimum resolution of 300 DPI is required for print quality, though a higher resolution is preferred. You can check the official guidelines here [link].

What I need:
High-resolution, print-ready PDF (and source PSD file) aligned perfectly to the provided KDP template so it passes Amazon KDP's upload verification without errors.
We know exactly how we want it to look so it matches our existing book series; we just lack the Photoshop skills to scale, align, and format it accurately to the template specifications.

Budget: $25 (via PayPal or preferred method)
Please comment below with a link to your portfolio or examples of previous book cover/print formatting work if interested. Please keep all communications in the comments/DMs per sub rules.
